:::{#exm-pair-encoding}
#### Encoding the pair $10$ and $0$

The [pair encoding](#def-pair-encoding) of $w = 10$ and $x = 0$ is

$$\angb{10, 0} = 1100010.$$

It consists of $11$ and $00$ for the two digits of $w$,
then $01$,
then the single digit of $x$.
Reading two digits at a time gives $11$, $00$, and then $01$,
which marks the end of $w$.

:::
